title: [Known Issue] Thunderbird printing empty PDF files.
creator: edhem.njorka
content:
Edit: Just saw it was already a known issue: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1959171

I've found out that on both Linux and Windows since the last update (154.0), the PDFs printed directly from the Thunderbird PDF viewer, prints out blank PDF.

To recreate this, open a PDF attachment in an email, simple double click on it, in the top right corner on the tool bar, press the little printer icon, choose either "Save as PDF" or print to the actual printer, in both cases, you will get one blank PDF page.
